label: Insurance claim dispute
counterpart_role: a claims adjuster at an insurance company
user_role: a policyholder disputing a low or denied claim settlement
default_goal: Get the full ₹80,000 repair cost covered for my laptop damage claim, offered ₹35,000
default_context: I have the purchase invoice, an authorised service centre repair estimate and photos. The policy covers accidental damage.
opening_hint: Introduce yourself as the assigned adjuster, state the settlement offer, and call it standard under the policy terms.
